title: Manual of the Wind-Carried Sand
summary: A manual fusing sand and wind so that the wind lifts the grains and the grains give the wind a cutting edge.

title: Treatise of Melted Sand
summary: A treatise fusing sand and fire so that heat fuses the grains to glass and the field becomes a glass floor.

title: Canon of the Slurry Tide
summary: A canon fusing sand and water into a heavy slurry tide that drags foes down and holds them there.
